text:
Maya: FYI p99 for /v1/generate in eu-1 spiked at ~13:04 UTC right after we pushed the routing change to prefer-dedicated. p50/p95 unchanged, p99 up.

ploy-bot: routing-policy change applied to service "generator" at 2025-03-14T13:03:47Z by @Ben

Ben: I flipped it expecting lower latency overall. odd that only p99 moved.

Priya: can you paste the console query you used? my first thought is sample-origin mixing causing noise.

Maya: we use this (approx):
```
SELECT quantile(0.99)(latency_ms)
FROM requests
WHERE route='/v1/generate' AND region='eu-1'
GROUP BY endpoint
```
Note: backend rollups are tdigest compressed.

Jason: tdigest + small sample counts can make p99 jumpy. check sample_count and origin tags for that minute.

Lina: checked raw: dedicated path had 12 samples in the 1-min bucket at 13:04, gateway had ~520. dedicated p99=480ms; combined rollup pulled the overall p99 up.

Ben: makes sense. UX request: show sample_count next to p50/p95/p99 and a light warning badge when sample_count < 50. also a quick per-origin breakdown (gateway|dedicated|fallback) in the latency pane.

Priya: agree. short-term: tooltip on hover with per-origin counts and a yellow "noisy" badge when any origin < 50. long-term: toggle "Break down percentiles by origin".

Maya: quick prototype param: `?breakdown=origin&min_samples=50` — returns per-origin percentiles and hides the overall pctl if any origin < min_samples. helpful for debugging.

Ben: low-risk. grouping by origin should be cheap, but will it increase query cost noticeably?

Jason: group-by is cheap if we still have origin labels in rollups. if rollups are merged without provenance we can't reconstruct per-origin pcts; we'd need per-origin rollups or keep origin in rollup keys.

Lina: opened INF-4231 to add provenance tags to rollup keys. linking infra ticket.

Ben: prioritizing INF-4231 for next minor. meanwhile we'll ship tooltip + warning badge in console (low lift).

Maya: proposed warning copy: "Warning 14 reported p99 is based on X samples across origins and may be noisy. Click to see per-origin breakdown." ok?

Priya: :thumbsup: I'll PR the tooltip + wordsmithing and add a unit test for threshold logic.

Jason: adding telemetry so we can track how often the warning shows (avoid spamming users).

Lina: INF-4231: https://redwood.internal/INF-4231

Maya: monitoring for the next hour and will follow up after PR lands.
